payload.partitioning:
Relation meaning: 'must share the same state' (chiefly: where does iteration X live?). Coupling, classified:
- Isolate <-> Locate: STRONG - both hinge on 'where iteration X lives' (its worktree home). This is the crux coupling - the routing decision.
- Locate <-> Drive: STRONG - Drive operates on whatever Locate finds.
- Adapt <-> Drive: MEDIUM - Drive serves states from the (possibly trimmed) machine Adapt produced.
- Reunify <-> Isolate: MEDIUM - Reunify folds back the line Isolate created.
- Prove: cross-cutting - it exercises the whole chain.
- Guide: DECOUPLED - pure guidance text, no runtime coupling.
Clusters:
- C1 LOCATION/ROUTING {Isolate, Locate, Drive, Reunify} - all bound by 'where iteration X lives'; the routing decision lives here.
- C2 PROCESS-ADAPTATION {Adapt} - the local-machine cluster (interfaces Drive).
- C3 ACCEPTANCE {Prove} - cross-cutting, the live test.
- C4 GUIDANCE {Guide} - standalone doc fix.
Qualities: Isolate/Locate/Drive/Reunify = basic (core); Adapt = additional; Prove = safety (guards the regression); Guide = support.
